Assets.NotesMarkdown: Backoffice 1.0.97: Brand: one logo everywhere (the mark and the name in two colours) in the header, on the sign-in card and in the status bar. Buy, sell and hedge buttons have the soft glow look, and text selection is blue instead of the brand accent; drop-downs close when you click elsewhere. Dealing: the Hedge account sits under the Hedge manager and the Queue spans the full bottom width; Dealer P/L and Book P/L are blue for profit and red for loss; the one-click strip shows the symbol above the buttons with the collapse arrow at its edge; the auto-hedge chip reads "Auto-hedge: Off" with the groups on hover; the chart has a blue take-profit box and a red stop-loss box clipped to the plot, stacked position labels and the hovered candle in its header. The Hedge manager column that mixed up its figures is now named Dealer P/L, the positions' column is Client P/L, and the hedge account counts Positions. Dashboard: Close to stop-out lists only accounts under their margin-call level (otherwise None); zero values are no longer coloured; staff activity has Today / Yesterday / date separators, reads "Hedge opened" and no longer cuts text; margin levels above 9,999 show as >9,999%; the price feed line opens Price feed health to show which symbols are quiet; the lower band is only as tall as its rows (a draggable bar sets it, Reset layout restores it) and Needs attention gets the space. Liquidity: an empty provider list shows Add provider and no side panel; the unhedged card says A-book; the Needs attention card names A-book groups without a routing rule. Everywhere: panels show their title only (no section numbers), the notification count stops at 99+, "Updated 23:11 UTC" replaces the long time stamp, dates read 25 Oct 23:12, and B-book, A-book, Reverse trading and Hedge account are spelled the same way. The Market Watch direction squares say what they mean on hover, and "Closed today: 0 client trades" reads plainly. Live exposure: Close all shown also closes positions of internal accounts (only real hedge legs stay out), the header counts hedge legs and internal rows apart, and every skipped or refused row is counted with its reason. Leverage is checked on the account, new account, approval and group forms before anything is sent: it must be a whole number, an account stays within its group, a group within the broker's maximum leverage, and the reason shows at the form (the maximum is set under Settings by an admin); moving a client to a lower-leverage group first shows the server's new leverage, margin used and margin level, and is refused below stop-out. Client view: an Order ticket tab for admins and managers with trading rights (market orders with a confirm; limit, stop and manual positions show as coming with the next server update), and the footer shows the server's opening balance, or the date the account opened, instead of a zero initial balance. Chart: position labels use the buy, sell, take-profit and stop-loss colours and stay readable on any candle. Tooltips: every tooltip now appears fully drawn in the app font after a short delay, and a tooltip with no text never opens. The chart now fills in minutes it missed, including after a connection drop.
